notes.title: new games & fixes: No Man's Sky, Cyberdrifter ...
notes.content:
new games & fixes (updates automatically):

* NO MAN SKY PROBLEM is solved. Oh Yeah! That was incredibly hard. In NMS the movement follows a 3D vector of the joystick on the hand controller (in Stand Out, or Cyberdrifter as well). Whereas other games follow a projected 2D vector of the joystick (Onward, Fallout). We've learned a lot about quaternions, and how to intersect planes with rays using matrices, and many more.

* FALLOUT 4 Pipboy map is fixed and jump is added. Please reload community binding.

* Cyberdrifter added!
* Axegend added!
* Wakamarina Valley, New Zealand fixed
* VR exploration set (Iceland and Fushimi temple) added!

notes.title: Google Earth VR
notes.content:
Happy Easter Cyberbuddies, 

To make Google Earth VR compatible with your Cybershoes - it is probably the most appropriate thing to do for this 2020 Easter. Despite home isolation - now you can visit your birthplace, favorite vacation spot, the city you always wanted to see or you can simply put the shoes on and explore spaceship earth.  

Google Earth in VR is a great App and it is free, so why not give it a shot. 

In-Game Settings: 

* You follow the left-hand direction
* There are 2 speeds
* For Oculus: Swap left / right controller

Fixed human scale = ON

DOWNLOAD LINK

notes.title: Half-Life: Alyx Need for Speed
notes.content:
Need for Speed >>> Steam Launch Settings:

1. Locate the game Half-Life:Alyx in Steam Library
2. Right click the game
3. Enter: 
+hlvr_continuous_normal_speed 200
+hlvr_continuous_combat_speed 200

to copy the text: www.3d.run/Alyx

In-Game Settings:
Movement: CONTINUOUS
Accessibility/Height Adjust: CROUCH (AND STAND)

notes.title: Zero Caliber VR
notes.content:
Ok, not planned so but this is gonna be a hell of FPS week. 
Zero Caliber has a well-made weapon handling, physics, and movement. CO-OP campaigns are screaming for one gaming night with the shoes. Who's in?  

Use this Controls Setting for Cybershoes: 


 Dominant Hand: RIGHT
 Click to run: OFF
 Auto Grip: OFF
 Auto Ungrip: OFF
 Grip mode: TOGGLE GRIP
 Orientation: HEAD-ORIENTED
 Controller Dead Zone: 0.11
 Turning: SNAP


For VIVE, INDEX, WMR and QUEST (via Virtual desktop) is straightforward. 
For Rift (s) read this: 3d.run/oc

For more info about compatible games check this list:

GAMES WITH CYBERSHOES

notes.content:

* How to force an update:
On top left corner of desktop steam window: choose STEAM then EXIT.
Open steam again, now the update is detected.
Goto downloads, tell it to download now.
You may need to launch Cybershoes once after steamVR is started.
Or, just restart your PC ;)

notes.title: 1st update that is brought to you via Steam
notes.content:
